name: ProtonDB Checker
description:
Check Steam game compatibility details directly from the GNOME Panel.

How to use: Click the gamepad icon in the panel, search for a game, and select it from the list.

Requirement: An active internet connection is needed to fetch data.

Disclaimer: This extension uses data and services from Steam and ProtonDB but is not affiliated with Valve or ProtonDB.

Note: This extension is in early development. Feedback is welcome!
